title: Running the clean-template machine
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be an input word over $\Gamma$, and choose a source tape among the $m$ work tapes. Suppose the starting configuration is in the sweep entry state and that, at every offset $q$ from $-1$ through the length of the joined fields $u,v$, the source tape stores the joined-field tape content at offset $q-(h-|u|-1)$, where $h$ is the source head's initial position. After exactly $3|u|+2|v|+9$ steps, the machine is in its designated exit state, the source tape is blank everywhere, and its head is at position $h-|u|-1$; every earlier configuration avoids the exit state, and at every time up to and including the final time every work-tape head is within distance $|u|+|v|+2$ of its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: Source tape index among the $m$ work tapes
Initial state is the sweep entry state
Source tape has the stated joined-fields contents for all offsets from $-1$ through the joined-fields length
